title: 67 (Six Seven)
blurb: Six... seven! The two numbers that broke a generation. Born from a Skrilla track and turbocharged by basketball edits, 67 became Gen Alpha's inside joke — a call-and-response chant with hand gestures, screamed in classrooms worldwide until teachers begged for mercy. It means nothing. It means everything. Ask a kid what 67 means and watch them short-circuit trying to explain. Peak brainrot, perfectly preserved.
origin: From Skrilla's 'Doot Doot (6 7)', amplified by basketball edits into a global Gen Alpha chant.
